responsibility: Defines rustc_ast’s core attribute and meta-item support: it allocates and tracks attribute IDs, provides query/accessor APIs over `Attribute`, `AttrItem`, `MetaItem`, and `MetaItemInner`, parses and interprets attribute token forms into meta items and literals, constructs common attribute/doc-comment AST nodes, and exposes helper searches over attribute collections.
same_name_distinction: Unlike `expand/mod.rs`, this `mod.rs` is the attribute subsystem’s implementation root: it defines and manipulates `Attribute`/`MetaItem` data directly, including ID generation, token-to-meta parsing, constructors, and attribute search helpers. It is the source of `MetaItem`, which the expansion module merely imports for its cfg-stripping record.
